test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vice President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Vice President,** during their tenure, assumes the **duty of serving as the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha**.
 
• This role is designated as an **'ex-officio' position, **signifying that the individual holds the position of Rajya Sabha Chairman by virtue of their **office as Vice President**.
 
• According to** Article 63** of the Constitution of India, provision is made for the existence of a Vice President of India.
 
• Articles 64 and 89(1) specify that the Vice President of India shall automatically serve as the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States, namely the Rajya Sabha, and is prohibited from holding any other office that yields profit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Rajya Sabha**, constitutionally designated as the **Council of States**, serves as the upper house of the bicameral Parliament of India.
 
• As of 2023, it boasts a maximum membership of** 250 individuals, comprising 238 members** elected by the legislatures of states and union territories via single transferable votes through open ballots, while the president retains the authority to appoint **12 members **based on their noteworthy contributions to fields such as art, literature, science, and social service.
 
• Article 80 of the Indian Constitution outlines the total permissible capacity of the Rajya Sabha as 250 members (238 elected and 12 appointed). Situated within Parliament House in New Delhi, the Rajya Sabha convenes in its eponymous chamber.
 
• Since July 18, 2018, the Rajya Sabha has been equipped with the capability for simultaneous interpretation in all 22 scheduled languages of India.
